newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan boy dies after clashes in Nairobi park.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan boy dies after clashes in Nairobi park.

text.p: Police said a boy found bleeding from his mouth and ears in a Nairobi park died on his way to hospital on Monday, the fourth person killed in Kenya during a day of violent clashes between police and demonstrators.
Police Spokesman Assistant Commissioner Peter Kimanthi said the boy was found by Red Cross staff bleeding from the mouth and ears in Uhuru park, where police beat and charged protesters on Monday.
"He was taken to hospital by the Red Cross but died on the way," Kimanthi told Reuters, adding an investigation would be launched to determine how he was killed.
Asked whether police involvement was suspected as police badly beat several demonstrators in the same park on Monday, Kimanthi said he could not say because no witnesses had come forward.

Kimanthi said a mob tried to storm the prison in Nyahururu, 100 km (60 miles) west of Nairobi, to free prisoners and one man was shot dead by prison authorities while police shot dead another man when a crowd tried to storm the Cooperative Bank.
He said a policeman was also shot and wounded in Nyahururu by a gunman shooting from a crowd and a boy was earlier killed in the town of Thika in an area where police were not active.
